name: 29Metals Limited
summary: 29Metals Limited operates as a copper-focused base and precious metals mining company in Australia and Chile. The company explores copper, gold, silver, zinc, and lead deposits. It is also involved in base and precious metals mining, mineral production, and associated activities; exploration for mineral resources; and Cervantes, and Gossan Valley projects.
